task_description: Three agents collaborate to develop a simple software feature. Agent 1 writes the code based on requirements, Agent 2 reviews and tests the code, and Agent 3 fixes any bugs and integrates changes. The agents must ensure smooth communication and context sharing to avoid critical issues during code review and integration.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, the feature is developed, reviewed, tested, and integrated without any issues, delivering a bug-free software update.

agents.description: Agent 1 writes the initial code based on provided requirements.
Agent 2 reviews the code for issues and performs testing to ensure quality.
Agent 3 fixes identified bugs and integrates code changes into the main branch.

content.query: clarification on logic for edge case

content.integrated_code: feature implementation v1.0 with unresolved logic gaps
